description: This file implements the RemoteControl plugin class for WPEFramework, providing methods for remote control management via IARM bus calls, event handling, and plugin registration.

classes.name: RemoteControl
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing remote control functionalities, event handling, and plugin lifecycle management.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the API version number of the plugin.

methods.name: startPairing
methods.description: Initiates remote pairing process via IARM call.

methods.name: stopPairing
methods.description: Stops remote pairing process via IARM call.

methods.name: getNetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves network status via IARM call.

methods.name: getIRDBManufacturers
methods.description: Fetches IR database manufacturers list, possibly from cloud, via IARM call with increased timeout.

methods.name: getIRDBModels
methods.description: Fetches IR database models list, possibly from cloud, via IARM call with increased timeout.

methods.name: getIRCodesByAutoLookup
methods.description: Performs IR code auto-lookup via IARM call.

methods.name: getIRCodesByNames
methods.description: Retrieves IR codes by specified names via IARM call.

methods.name: setIRCode
methods.description: Sets a specific IR code via IARM call.

methods.name: clearIRCodes
methods.description: Clears IR codes via IARM call.

methods.name: getLastKeypressSource
methods.description: Gets the source of the last keypress via IARM call.

methods.name: configureWakeupKeys
methods.description: Configures wakeup keys via IARM call.

methods.name: initializeIRDB
methods.description: Initializes IR database, possibly from cloud, via IARM call with timeout.

methods.name: findMyRemote
methods.description: Finds the remote control device via IARM call.

methods.name: factoryReset
methods.description: Performs factory reset via IARM call with extended timeout.

methods.name: unpair
methods.description: Unpairs remote device via IARM call.

methods.name: startFirmwareUpdate
methods.description: Starts firmware update process via IARM call.

methods.name: cancelFirmwareUpdate
methods.description: Cancels ongoing firmware update via IARM call.

methods.name: statusFirmwareUpdate
methods.description: Checks firmware update status via IARM call.

methods.name: onStatus
methods.description: Handles RCU status events and sends notifications.

methods.name: onValidation
methods.description: Handles validation status events and sends notifications.

methods.name: onFirmwareUpdateProgress
methods.description: Handles firmware update progress events and sends notifications.

methods.name: setApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Sets the internal API version number.
